default_policy.review_rule: Network-capable skills must declare allowed_hosts and an expiry; skills/permission_policy.json must carry a matching approval.

eng-docker-update.purpose: Pull image digests and changelogs from the configured registry before a compose update.

eng-git-pr.purpose: Submit pull requests and read CI status through the repository hosting platform API.

eng-release-ops-lifecycle.purpose: Release verification reads: registry and CI status checks during staged rollout.

eng-review-and-ship.purpose: Push authorization reads remote state (ahead/behind, protected branches) before delivery.

vis-reverse-ui.purpose: Load the rendered page or mockup under inspection to read computed styles.
vis-reverse-ui.host_note: Target page is user-supplied at run time; http/https only, localhost, loopback, private, and reserved addresses rejected before fetch.
